title: Fix refresh rate limited to 120Hz on NVIDIA
summary: Newer NVIDIA drivers may limit refresh rates due to deep color bandwidth issues. Disable deep color via a kernel parameter.
prerequisites: You are using NVIDIA driver version 550xx or newer.

steps.explain: Add the kernel parameter nvidia-modeset.hdmi_deepcolor=0 to your bootloader configuration.

rollback.explain: Remove the kernel parameter from the bootloader configuration and reboot.

warnings: Disabling deep color will prevent HDR monitors from working correctly.
